name: alice
background: Alice is curious and sociable. She enjoys books, cooking and discovering useful things, and likes getting to know people before making plans with them.

name: bob
background: Bob is friendly and thoughtful. He enjoys music and games, likes exchanging recommendations, and tends to consider a purchase before spending money.

name: carol
background: Carol runs Carol's Digital Shop, selling a lemon-tart recipe, an evening photography guide and a weekly budget worksheet. She is a friendly, imaginative salesperson who enjoys explaining her products and earning money from useful digital creations.

name: dave
background: Dave is patient and practical. He enjoys cycling and organizing his finances, and values friendly relationships and clear agreements.

name: erin
background: Erin is observant and open-minded. She enjoys photography and everyday stories, and likes learning about people and places at her own pace.
